title: No thermal insulating or light blocking
text:
No thermal insulating or light blocking. Whomever decided that these curtains are "thermal insulated" and "room darkening " needs to read the English dictionary. They are neither of these things. As regular curtains, they are fine. The thin material is soft and the turquoise color is attractive.

I wanted these for our RV to cut the Western afternoon sun and heat. Not so much. We have high end, real thermal insulating, room darkening drapes and they do exactly that. This set allows sun and heat to come through - there is no third fabric layer for insulation or light blocking. If you need those properties, definitely buy a different brand.

product_metadata.title: Deconovo Blackout Curtains, Gray Bedroom Curtains, Thermal Insulated Room Darkening Window Panels for Living Room, Kitchen - 2 Panels, 52x72 in, Dark Grey

BEAUTIFUL DESIGN - Designed with a soft feel fabric, a silver foil printed line pattern and a beautiful drape, the Deconovo geometric line foil print blackout curtain with grommets adds personality to your interior while providing maximum privacy all day long

BLACKOUT EFFECT - This room darkening blackout curtains reduce sunlight and streetlight to up to 98% for an increased comfort for you and your loved ones (Choose a darker color for a deep darkening effect)

INCREASED COMFORT - Help reduce summer heat, winter cold and outdoor sounds by keeping room temperature steady for a fresh home. Ideal for the living room, the bedroom, the kitchen, office room and so on

EASY CARE - Designed for the everyday busy home owners with a lightweight smooth fabric for effortless hanging and easy of care. Hand wash only in cold water (Max 86°F), do not bleach, do not tumble dry. Iron at low heat, recommend the back
